rules: Every new head field begins in its existing cold-released nominal u; no independent exact input added.
Each one-shot event is written once; inverse address and all complement sectors remain retained.
No baton overwrites grips, active phase controls, token, fault or immutable fault copy.
Source/endpoint0/endpoint1 use distinct retained baton banks; no baton cleanup or overwrite is required.
Each local scratch is reversibly cleared before forward ACK; copied predecessor packet and all completion history stay retained.
Token/cargo freeze at docking; receipt/acquisition-field freeze follows late home ACK and local scratch clearance, through seal.
New couriers use endpoint-layout fields; immutable fault, positive banks and every spent remainder persist through seal.
